$comment: The shared product block (#2608): headline, subtitle, business chain and the six apps, per docs locale. App NAMES are not here: they are read from src/ into apps.generated.json, except zh-Hant, which has no pack and is authored under appsHant as the zh-CN wording in Traditional characters. Links are locale-neutral; the site adds the locale prefix. test/docs-product-block.test.ts holds this file to the metadata.

en.headline: Leads, orders, projects, cash and expenses in one open-source business system.
en.subtitle: Change it with AI when your business changes. Let your own AI agents work in it with each user's permissions.

chain.title: One chain, from the first lead to the cash
chain.note: Approved hours, travel and expenses on a project count in its cost, so the margin is measured against what the customer pays.

apps.title: Six apps
apps.intro: Everyone opens the app for their job. Sales is always there; an administrator can switch the other five off.

crm_enterprise.what: Leads, accounts, opportunities, quotes and products, orders and contracts.

crm_service.what: Cases with SLAs and escalation, and the knowledge base.

crm_marketing.what: Campaigns, and the leads and contacts they reach.

crm_o2c.what: Each contract's collection plan, invoices and payments: what is invoiced, paid and overdue.

crm_psa.what: Projects, staffing, plans, timesheets and budgets, with cost and margin.

crm_expenses.what: Expenses with their receipts, expense reports, travel requests and their approval.

zh-Hans.headline: 线索、订单、项目、回款、报销，一套开源的业务系统
zh-Hans.subtitle: 业务变了，让 AI 帮你改系统；你的 AI 助手用你的权限替你办事。

chain.title: 从第一条线索到回款，一条链
chain.note: 项目上已批准的工时、差旅和费用计入项目成本，毛利按客户实际支付的金额来衡量。

apps.title: 六个应用
apps.intro: 每个人打开与自己工作对应的应用。销售始终都在；其他五个管理员可以停用。

crm_enterprise.what: 线索、客户、商机、报价与产品、订单和合同。

crm_service.what: 带 SLA 和升级的工单，以及知识库。

crm_marketing.what: 营销活动，以及它们触达的线索和联系人。

crm_o2c.what: 每份合同的回款计划、发票和回款：开了多少票、收了多少钱、有没有逾期。

crm_psa.what: 项目、人员安排、计划、工时单和预算，以及成本和毛利。

crm_expenses.what: 带票据的费用、报销单、出差申请及其审批。

zh-Hant.headline: 線索、訂單、項目、回款、報銷，一套開源的業務系統
zh-Hant.subtitle: 業務變了，讓 AI 幫你改系統；你的 AI 助手用你的權限替你辦事。

chain.title: 從第一筆線索到回款，一條鏈
chain.note: 項目上已核准的工時、差旅和費用計入項目成本，毛利按客戶實際支付的金額來衡量。

apps.title: 六個應用
apps.intro: 每個人打開與自己工作對應的應用。銷售始終都在；其他五個管理員可以停用。

crm_enterprise.what: 線索、客戶、商機、報價與產品、訂單和合約。

crm_service.what: 帶 SLA 和升級的工單，以及知識庫。

crm_marketing.what: 營銷活動，以及它們觸達的線索和聯絡人。

crm_o2c.what: 每份合約的回款計劃、發票和回款：開了多少票、收了多少錢、有沒有逾期。

crm_psa.what: 項目、人員安排、計劃、工時單和預算，以及成本和毛利。

crm_expenses.what: 帶票據的費用、報銷單、出差申請及其審批。
